psychological_meaning: International Klein Blue (IKB) is a deep, vivid blue that evokes feelings of vastness, transcendence, and intellectual stimulation. It's often associated with the infinite, the spiritual, and a sense of calm depth. The color's intensity can also inspire creativity and a sense of wonder.

real_world_examples.title: Yves Klein's monochrome paintings
real_world_examples.description: Yves Klein famously used IKB in his monochrome paintings to achieve a sense of pure color and spiritual depth.

real_world_examples.title: Fashion Runway
real_world_examples.description: Designers have incorporated IKB into runway collections, often in minimalist designs to emphasize the color's boldness.

how_to_pair: Pair with white for a clean, modern look.
Combine with gold for a luxurious feel.
Use with orange for a vibrant contrast.
Soften with pastel blues for a calming effect.
